description.zh: sql风格数据库右模糊匹配模式，支持%。
description.en: The SQL-style right fuzzy match pattern for database names. The percent sign (%) wildcard is supported.

description.zh: 翻页令牌，用于获取下一页数据。如果响应结果中没有提供，则传空字符串（""）或空字符（''）。
description.en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. If the response does not include this token, pass an empty string ("") or an empty character ('').
